01-whatsapp-intake.msg: A customer asks for a price on WhatsApp.
01-whatsapp-intake.queue: Seconds later it is an enquiry in the queue, linked to their company.
01-whatsapp-intake.asks: The assistant spots what is missing and asks once: here, the container type.
01-whatsapp-intake.thread: The whole conversation stays on the enquiry, with what the assistant sent.
01-whatsapp-intake.read: Every detail is read from the chat, with the exact words it came from.
01-whatsapp-intake.accept: Nothing is saved until a person accepts it.
01-whatsapp-intake.ready: Accepted, the enquiry is complete and ready to price.

02-rates-and-quotations.request: Ask every partner who covers the route for a price, in one click.
02-rates-and-quotations.replies: Their email replies are read into prices, converted and compared.
02-rates-and-quotations.award: The winning reply becomes a rate card, so the next quote prices itself.
02-rates-and-quotations.price: {app:quote.priceIt} adds the customer’s margin. Buy, sell and margin sit side by side.
02-rates-and-quotations.quote: A draft quotation is ready, with the margin you will make.
02-rates-and-quotations.send: Send it. The margin freezes and the customer can accept it online.

03-customer-accepts-quote.list: Your customer signs in to their own portal and sees every price you sent.
03-customer-accepts-quote.detail: Every charge, your covering note and the date the offer ends.
03-customer-accepts-quote.accept: She accepts with one click. No email or phone call needed.
03-customer-accepts-quote.office: The office sees it at once, and one click opens the shipment with the agreed prices.

04-shipments-and-milestones.board: The Shipments page lists every live shipment and where it stands.
04-shipments-and-milestones.milestones: Each step keeps a planned, a revised and an actual date.
04-shipments-and-milestones.record: When the vessel arrives, record it on the day.
04-shipments-and-milestones.stage: {app:jobActions.setStatus} changes the stage, and the customer’s tracking page follows.
04-shipments-and-milestones.track: Customers track it themselves with the reference and a container number.

05-documents-and-house-bill.panel: Four documents are built from the shipment’s own parties and cargo lines.
05-documents-and-house-bill.preview: Preview any of them in English or Arabic. A preview stores nothing.
05-documents-and-house-bill.issue: Issue keeps the exact copy handed over. A new version never overwrites it.
05-documents-and-house-bill.release: Release is a separate decision: only then can the customer see it.
05-documents-and-house-bill.register: Every document, every version, in one register.

06-invoicing-and-payments.unbilled: Shipments with charges nobody has invoiced yet are listed for finance.
06-invoicing-and-payments.draft: Draft invoice copies the agreed charges onto a draft in one click.
06-invoicing-and-payments.issue: Approve, then issue. Issuing gives the next number and cannot be undone.
06-invoicing-and-payments.receipt: When the money arrives, record the receipt and match it to the invoice.
06-invoicing-and-payments.paid: The invoice shows as paid, here and in the customer’s portal.

07-supplier-bills.board: Payables shows what partners have billed, and where it disagrees with the shipment.
07-supplier-bills.capture: Capture the agent’s bill exactly as they printed it.
07-supplier-bills.match: Match each line to the cost the shipment expected. The verdict says if it agrees.
07-supplier-bills.approve: Only finance approves it for payment, with any difference in front of them.

08-reports.totals: The margin report totals revenue, cost and gross profit for the shipments that sailed.
08-reports.lane: Group it by customer, trade lane, mode or salesperson.
08-reports.mode: Or by mode, to see which kind of freight pays best.
08-reports.export: {app:reports.exportCsv} takes the whole report into a spreadsheet.
08-reports.kpis: The dashboard puts win rate and average margin side by side. Read them together.

09-arabic.switch: One click switches the whole product to Arabic.
09-arabic.rtl: The layout reads right to left, with the menu on the right.
09-arabic.enquiry: The same records, in Arabic: the enquiry and its WhatsApp conversation.
09-arabic.quote: Quotations and documents follow, with an Arabic PDF for every one.
09-arabic.track: Customer pages follow the same choice, like public tracking.
09-arabic.back: Switch back to English the same way.
